[[The Hunting of the Charr]] }} Find out what happened to a squad of [[Ebon Vanguard]] soldiers tasked with tracking down a [[Charr]] leader. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== * You must first listen to the conversation that [[Sergeant Weststar]] is having with his troops just outside [[Longeye's Ledge]] in [[Grothmar Wardowns]]. ===Objectives=== * Discover the fate of [[Jenn Valefield]]. * Discern the fate of [[Chance Redding]]. * Divine the fate of [[Sergeant Weststar]]. ===Reward=== * 100 [[Ebon Vanguard rank|Vanguard reputation points]] * {{skill icon|Ebon Vanguard Sniper Support}} ==Walkthrough== This quest can be completed without fighting at all (e.g. by [[run]]ning). However, the following quest The Hunting of the Charr cannot. After listening to the conversation, go to Dalada Uplands and head down to the southeast corner where the [[portal]] to [[Sacnoth Valley]] is. You may want to pick up the [[Siege Devourer]] on the way. Look for the [[Corpse of Brave Brent Poltroon]] nearby and investigate the corpse to obtain the quest. Head through the portal into Sacnoth Valley. Once there follow the quest marker that points to the location of each [[Non-player character|NPC]] you need to contact. After speaking to each NPC they will follow your party to the next location. [[Jenn Valefield]] is to the south sitting beneath a tree in a field with a dozen stone elementals nearby. [[Chance Redding]] is your next target. He is located in the middle of the [[zone]], just south of where the zone name appears on the [[World Map]]. [[Sergeant Weststar]] is in the southwest corner of the zone, having followed [[Rake Blazeclaw]] here. Speaking to Sergeant Weststar completes the quest. ==NPCs== In [[Sacnoth Valley]]: ===Allies=== [[Human]]s ([[Ebon Vanguard]]) *{{w}} 20 [[Chance Redding]] *{{w}} 20 [[Sergeant Weststar]] *{{mo}} 20 [[Jenn Valefield]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== '''Corpse of Brave Brent Poltroon''' :''*The body of Brave Brent Poltroon lies before you, replete with savage and grisly wounds. It appears Brent's suspicions were not baseless after all, and he has been chewed on by a Charr. What fate has befallen the '''other Ebon Vanguard'''?*'' {{offer dialog |accept = I hope the others aren't this...gnawed. |decline = I'm too pretty to be a chew toy! |ask = The wounds on the body are still fresh. There's a chance that the others may yet be saved, if you can find them within '''''Sacnoth Valley'''''. }} ===Intermediate dialogue=== Finding Jenn: :'''Jenn Valefield:''' ''At last! A familiar face amongst this madness.'' :'''Jenn Valefield:''' ''We were attacked by...something. I couldn't see what it was. Just that it was enormous.'' :'''Jenn Valefield:''' ''We had to run, and we were separated. I'm not sure where the others are.'' :'''Jenn Valefield:''' ''I'll go with you. we need to find Chance and the Captain,{{sic}} and make sure that they're all right.'' Finding Chance: :'''Chance Redding:''' ''Ah! Back, Charr! Oh, it's you two. It's a good thing you're here...I'm holding up, but Mr. Pointy was getting a little nervous.'' :'''Chance Redding:''' ''I was about to roust every Charr in the place...as soon as I stop bleeding when I move. Anytime now.'' :'''Chance Redding:''' ''Maybe I'm too injured to fight, but I can still offer inspiring homilies to pump us up for battle!'' :'''Chance Redding:''' ''Eh, let's just find the Sergeant before Blazeclaw turns him into short ribs.'' ===Reward dialogue=== ;Sergeant Weststar :''<[[Character]] name>, Jenn, Chance. I'm gratified you're not dead. Rake Blazeclaw and another Charr attacked me and headed into the dungeon. We are safe for now, but this isn't over yet. It may be worse than we thought. Those Charr said they were meeting another of their kind named Rragar. There is something insidious afoot, and whatever it is, can only bode ill for us if they aren't stopped.'' == Notes == *Enemies cannot [[target]] nor harm Jenn and Chance. == Trivia == *Chance Redding's allusion to Mr. Pointy is a reference to the TV show [[w:Buffy the Vampire Slayer (TV series)|Buffy the Vampire Slayer]]; "Mr. Pointy" is the nickname given to a stake by Kendra.
